ruleDefinitions.name: File Download From IP URL Via Curl.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects file downloads directly from IP address URL using curl.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "curl\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX("://[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-O.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-remote\\-name.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-output.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.gif$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.gif\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.jpeg$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.jpeg\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.log$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.log\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.png$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.png\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.gif\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.jpeg\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.log\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.png\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs\\$")))
